A Little About Me

Hello, I'm Sophie, an independent digital marketing freelancer passionate about helping businesses present their products and connect with their audiences.

Over the past six years, I have gained experience promoting products across different categories, including skincare and hair care through Joyherbals, as well as handmade crochet accessories, western tops, overcoats and keychains.

These experiences have helped me appreciate how product presentation, clear messaging and an understanding of customer interests can shape the way people discover and perceive a brand.

My approach to marketing is simple: understand the business, communicate what makes its products valuable, and develop promotional ideas that connect with the right audience.

Whether you're an emerging business, an established brand or an independent creator, I'd love to explore how I can help you present your business more effectively online.

My Approach

  1. Understand the business and its audience.
  2. Plan relevant promotional content.
  3. Create clear and engaging marketing materials.
  4. Review available performance data.
  5. Identify opportunities for improvement.
